name: Process-bus redundant-network interface
summary: Separates the two documented process-network paths serving a redundant communication arrangement.
description: Separates the two documented process-network paths serving a redundant communication arrangement. Digital substation interfaces carry measurements, status and control information between primary equipment and protective devices. Measurement streams, event messages and time synchronization are separate dependencies even when they share an Ethernet network.

In a digital substation bay, a merging unit digitizes local measurements and a protective relay subscribes to the assigned data stream. The command return path and communication-health indications are drawn separately. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Two network paths” at the input and “Redundant data transport” at the output. Network names alone do not prove independent failure paths.
